reviewCadence: quarterly and before any new provider or personal-data field ships

owners.platform_privacy: OnPrez operator: account, platform-security, analytics, provider and rights-request records
owners.business_controller: Business owner: customer, inquiry, review, booking-note and business-content records
owners.finance_operations: OnPrez operator and business owner: payment, refund, dispute and accounting records
owners.security_operations: OnPrez operator: authentication, abuse-prevention, audit and incident records

processingActivities.purpose: Create accounts, authenticate users, manage sessions and provide account security controls
processingActivities.lawfulBasis: contract and legitimate interests in platform security
processingActivities.retention: active account; routine security records normally up to 30 days; active incidents may be held longer

processingActivities.purpose: Publish and operate the business presence page and team workspace
destinations: public web only when explicitly published
processingActivities.retention: active business plus up to 90 days after cancellation for orderly recovery/deletion

processingActivities.purpose: Create and manage bookings, inquiries, reviews, reminders and service communications
processingActivities.lawfulBasis: contract or requested pre-contract steps; business-defined lawful basis for CRM use
processingActivities.retention: normally up to two years after the interaction unless the business documents another lawful period

processingActivities.purpose: Collect deposits, reconcile payments, issue refunds and retain dispute/accounting evidence
processingActivities.retention: transactional facts retained only for the applicable accounting, dispute or legal period

processingActivities.purpose: Protect, diagnose and improve OnPrez without collecting form values or raw private routes
processingActivities.lawfulBasis: legitimate interests for security/diagnostics; consent for optional audience analytics
destinations: Google Analytics using coarse page groups only
processingActivities.retention: routine diagnostics normally up to 30 days; optional analytics no longer than 12 months

fieldPolicies.protection: plaintext_required; TLS in transit; provider/database encryption at rest; tenant or account access controls
fieldPolicies.retention: account/team lifecycle; verification tokens expire; auth attempts normally up to 30 days
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: delete with account/invitation or anonymise retained audit records

fieldPolicies.protection: one-way bcrypt hash; never exported or logged
fieldPolicies.retention: active account only
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: delete during terminal account processing

fieldPolicies.protection: keyed one-way hash at rest; raw value exists only during issuance/use; TLS and HttpOnly cookies where applicable
fieldPolicies.retention: until expiry, use or revocation
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: expire/revoke promptly and delete with account

fieldPolicies.protection: random single-purpose invitation credential, TLS and strict expiry; currently plaintext-required for lookup and recorded for migration to a keyed hash
fieldPolicies.retention: until acceptance, revocation or expiry
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: delete with invitation or business; never log/export

fieldPolicies.protection: application-level authenticated encryption; key held outside the database
fieldPolicies.retention: while MFA remains enabled
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: delete when MFA is disabled or the account is removed

fieldPolicies.protection: one-way hash; raw codes shown once
fieldPolicies.retention: until used, regenerated or MFA/account removal
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: delete on regeneration, MFA disablement or account removal

fieldPolicies.protection: plaintext required by current sender; TLS and strict account scoping; never exported/logged; application-level encryption is a recorded pre-paid-launch hardening decision
fieldPolicies.retention: active subscription; prune on expiry/provider 404 or 410/account deletion
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: delete subscription and delivery link

fieldPolicies.protection: plaintext required for security controls; restricted UI/API access; redacted from external diagnostics
fieldPolicies.retention: session/device lifetime; routine security/rate-limit records normally up to 30 days
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: delete with session/device/account or expire through security retention

fieldPolicies.protection: allowlisted operational facts only; structured logger and lifecycle contract prohibit contact details, secrets and payload copies
fieldPolicies.retention: routine security records normally up to 30 days; lifecycle evidence as required for the request/claim
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: minimise/anonymise; retain only documented evidence under a hold

fieldPolicies.protection: plaintext required; private in dashboard and public only after explicit publication/configuration
fieldPolicies.retention: active business plus published-content recovery/deletion window
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: unpublish immediately; delete after ownership, retention and provider review

fieldPolicies.protection: JSON is private; Google refresh token nested value uses AES-256-GCM; accountEmail/notification recipients remain plaintext and access-controlled
fieldPolicies.retention: active business/integration
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: disconnect providers, revoke tokens and remove settings during business deletion

fieldPolicies.protection: draft content tenant-private; published snapshot intentionally public; editors must not place customer PII in public content
fieldPolicies.retention: business/content lifecycle
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: unpublish/delete with business and remove editor link where required

fieldPolicies.protection: plaintext required for service delivery; tenant-scoped access; excluded from logs, analytics, push payloads and URLs
fieldPolicies.retention: normally up to two years after interaction unless controller documents another lawful period
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: verified anonymisation replaces identity with non-routable placeholder while retained facts remain

fieldPolicies.protection: plaintext, tenant-scoped and optional; collect only where necessary
fieldPolicies.retention: customer/business purpose and normally no longer than booking retention
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: erase during verified customer anonymisation

fieldPolicies.protection: plaintext/JSON, tenant-scoped; no special-category data by default and no copying to diagnostics
fieldPolicies.retention: documented business purpose only and normally no longer than customer retention
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: erase during verified customer anonymisation

fieldPolicies.protection: tenant-scoped plaintext/JSON; booking IP and notes excluded from logs, analytics, push and URLs
fieldPolicies.retention: booking lifecycle and normally up to two years, subject to disputes/legal holds
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: erase direct/free-text PII; retain only minimal timing/status/policy facts when justified

fieldPolicies.protection: tenant-scoped plaintext; purpose-bound transactional email only; excluded from logs/analytics/push/URLs
fieldPolicies.retention: inquiry/customer lifecycle and normally up to two years
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: replace identity/content and remove network identifiers during verified anonymisation

fieldPolicies.protection: tenant-private until explicitly published; publication must not expose unnecessary identifiers
fieldPolicies.retention: review/business relationship
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: unpublish and erase content during verified anonymisation

fieldPolicies.protection: tenant-scoped plaintext identifiers; payment card data is not stored by OnPrez; TLS to Stripe
fieldPolicies.retention: payment/dispute/accounting period
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: retain minimal provider references while legally/operationally required, then delete

fieldPolicies.protection: restricted operational data; provider errors must be scrubbed before persistence where possible
fieldPolicies.retention: payment/reminder evidence period; transient errors no longer than necessary
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: minimise/anonymise; retain only evidence required for accounting, disputes or incidents

fieldPolicies.protection: tenant-scoped IDs and one-way request digest; no raw request payload in audit fields
fieldPolicies.retention: booking lifecycle and justified audit period
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: detach/anonymise actor where required; retain minimal transition facts

fieldPolicies.protection: payload contains only service/time/coarse event and internal IDs; no customer identity/contact/notes; provider errors are bounded
fieldPolicies.retention: short delivery/retry audit window
fieldPolicies.deletionAction: delete with appointment/subscription or after delivery audit retention
